PhobosAutoNav.intro: Asterel plug-in boards for the native Polaris navigation station. Fit them into the station’s module slots and use the shared Phobos flight hub; they are not floor fixtures and have no INSTALL tile. Working N1/N2 provide navigation, while N3 supplies independent fire controls. Removing a module can suspend the function that owns it. Regional offers extend through the current vanilla solar system; see [market coverage and the game's market pricing](solar-system-economy.md). Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). Ordinary flight, FCS and Combat support one secured tow; release it before terminal docking or industrial close work. FCS uses only the piloted ship’s weapons and requires a separate fire target. See [towing controls and limits](auto-nav-towing.md).

groups.title: N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module
groups.function: Navigation, approach and docking assistance. It can stop short of a destination or use a separate docking command.
groups.use: Fit a working board to Polaris, open its Phobos hub, select a ship, station or asteroid your sensors track, set arrival preferences and choose Fly, Dock or Approach & Dock as appropriate. Asteroids need a live track within 1,000 km and support Fly only; the default arrival stops inside native tether reach. Details and phobosnav sensors show each sensor's signal. If the track is too faint, Auto Nav switches on the fewest sensors that fix it, non-emitting first, warns you on the nav map and in the crew log, and later switches off only its own. Use Stop to release flight control. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Build at a supported table, buy from the listed dealers, or find an N1/N2/N3 board in eligible native module loot. Damaged finds need repair.
groups.notes: Indefinite position holding is not promised. Sensor quality, braking room, fuel and native restrictions still apply. Docking resumes only after an explicit post-load Resume. Local obstacle avoidance uses tracked contacts, weak contacts within 100 km with extra clearance, and asteroid-field rocks; Auto Nav may switch on sensors to sharpen them, with a warning, and lost tracking requires Resume. Sensors are switched on only by explicit command. Explicit Undock & Depart / Undock & Continue prepare a 1 km hull-gap departure and require every crew member on the company roster aboard; missing or away crew block departure. See [departure and avoidance](auto-nav-departure.md).

groups.title: N2 Polaris Pursuit Module
groups.function: Includes navigation/docking and adds Rendezvous and Follow for moving contacts. With N3, explicit Combat matches the selected fire target while retaining the previous mission for Resume.
groups.use: Fit to Polaris and use the Pursuit page. Rendezvous approaches once; Follow maintains a distance band. Stop before changing flight modes. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Build at a supported table, buy from the listed dealers, or find an N1/N2/N3 board in eligible native module loot. Damaged finds need repair.
groups.notes: N2 does not authorize firing; use N3 for that. Pursuit suspends on reload and cannot guarantee catching a faster ship. Local obstacle avoidance uses tracked contacts, weak contacts within 100 km with extra clearance, and asteroid-field rocks; Auto Nav may switch on sensors to sharpen them, with a warning, and lost tracking requires Resume. Explicit Undock & Depart / Undock & Continue prepare a 1 km hull-gap departure and require every crew member on the company roster aboard; missing or away crew block departure. See [departure and avoidance](auto-nav-departure.md).

groups.title: N3 Polaris Fire Control System
groups.function: Independent weapon observations, bounded offensive volleys and optional RCS aiming. It can operate without N1/N2.
groups.use: Fit to Polaris, open Fire, choose a target and use Weapon group to see installed weapons, including off or damaged ones. Left-click Volleys to increase, right-click to decrease (1–9, wrapping). Engage grants a fresh firing budget. Cease Fire keeps offensive hold; Return to Native releases it. Switching an FCS-held group asks for confirmation: the old group may resume native automatic firing and the new group enters Hold with aiming off. See the [Polaris controls](development/polaris-interface-refresh.md).
groups.find: Build at a supported table, buy from the listed dealers, or find an N1/N2/N3 board in eligible native module loot. Damaged finds need repair.
groups.notes: Firing permission is not restored from a save. N2 plus N3 combines Follow and firing; flight braking and clearance take priority over aiming.

groups.title: Electronics assembly offcuts
groups.function: Retained material left over when any N1/N2/N3 board is constructed.
groups.use: Keep, haul or offer to a compatible scrap buyer.
groups.find: Appears beside the new board at construction completion.
groups.notes: The name still mentions N1, but all three board recipes share this identity. It is not a small electronic-parts item and has no current refining recipe.

groups.title: Board residue
groups.function: Terminal remainder from dismantling any working or damaged N1/N2/N3 board.
groups.use: Treat as retained scrap cargo; reuse or repair a board before choosing irreversible dismantling.
groups.find: Produced by the Dismantle action on a board.
groups.notes: The N1-labelled identity is shared across all three models. It cannot be refined into electronics by a current Phobos recipe.

PhobosShipbreaker.intro: Rivetline machinery recovers material and casts rough industrial products. Asterel C1 provides optional central controls. Obtain loose equipment, place it through the indicated native INSTALL tab, supply electricity where required, and keep service approaches accessible. Local panels remain usable without C1. Receiving, processing and hot-furnace controls are separate permissions. Pending-equipment reloads include a bounded room-grid mitigation; see [evidence and limits](development/shipbreaker-room-load-mitigation.md). It cannot recover atmosphere already lost before saving. Regional offers extend through the current vanilla solar system; see [market coverage and the game's market pricing](solar-system-economy.md). Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). In selection fields, Locate opens a temporary marked ship view; Clear is a draft change that requires Apply. Pick on ship marks eligible objects and Escape restores the panel and view.

groups.title: D4 Dismantling Fixture
groups.function: Processes detached structural parts (ordinary walls of any make, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows) into native scrap and parts; a wall also returns the identified residue packet, a lighter part a terminal reject.
groups.use: Install on cabin flooring and supply power. Put detached structural parts (ordinary walls of any make at 14 to 48 kg, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows) in its Part Feed through the Control Panel, switch on Load feed by crew so crew keep it loaded from anywhere aboard, or use the G4/H4 intake; then enable processing once and the queue waits for more. Products appear in the normal machine inventory. To move ordinary products out automatically, choose a storage container on the Routing page and Start unloading to storage; see [storage outputs](automatic-material-routing.md#storage-outputs-for-ordinary-products). Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy loose or damaged equipment, or build two D4-S sections and assemble the fixture. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Final assembly now takes place at the installation site through Install on a section or INSTALL > APPS; a complete loose machine keeps its direct Install action.
groups.notes: It does not cut attached hull walls. Doors, hatches, conduit, furniture and machinery are refused. Fresh wall jobs make identified R2 feed; older bound jobs retain their original mixed-residue output. Processing and storage unloading pause on reload.

groups.title: G4 Exterior Grabber
groups.function: Receives detached wall panels and, when explicitly enabled, cuts supported captured walls for the existing D4 chain.
groups.use: Install the G4/H4/D4 assembly with all four backing walls intact. Manual loading and intake still work. For automatic reclamation, bind the exact G4 and N1/N2 console to an owned, unoccupied wreck, then choose Start reclamation. Resume is required after loading or lost authority. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Requires Auto Nav and Framework; see the installation guide for current minimum versions. Cutting, feeding, release, outward retreat, traversal and recapture are sequenced. Cutting rejects its delivered electrical energy as heat through the D4 interior service area (at least 10 kPa and headroom below 40 C); this is authored gameplay cooling, not a simulated physical coolant circuit. Only empty, unstacked, undamaged ordinary walls of any make (14 to 48 kg) with retained floors/supports qualify. Target pressure must be at most 0.1 kPa. Stop retains the capture; Release is separate. Floors, other equipment, cargo and final supports remain.

groups.title: H4 Sealed Hull Chute
groups.function: Connects the exterior grabber and interior processor across intact structural flooring.
groups.use: Install in the documented G4 → H4 → D4 arrangement; align and power the associated equipment.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Backing walls remain the pressure barrier. The chute is not an open portal, pressure-cycling airlock or arbitrary conveyor network.

groups.title: C2 Residue Collector
groups.function: A finite physical cargo receiver for explicitly paired industrial outputs.
groups.use: Install on two structural floor tiles with a clear two-tile service walkway, or at the hull with the existing wall supports. Link the required machine/output port, select an exact filter and enable receiving. For Agriculture's optional Recycler capture, align the full two-tile pocket against the Recycler with the service side facing away; enable collection from the Recycler panel. Empty Inventory when full. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Full collectors block transfer; cargo stays at the sender. It does not jettison material or reduce ship mass. Furnace products need their explicit filter.

groups.title: R4 Scrap Reclaimer
groups.function: Reclaims identified R2 panel residue into steel, aluminium and terminal rejects.
groups.use: Supply power and adequate cabin atmosphere, load exact R2 feed locally, switch on Load feed by crew or enable a paired intake, then start processing. Set residue, aluminium and steel storage outputs independently; see [storage outputs](automatic-material-routing.md#storage-outputs-for-ordinary-products). Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy machinery or assemble two R4-S sections. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Final assembly now takes place at the installation site through Install on a section or INSTALL > APPS; a complete loose machine keeps its direct Install action.
groups.notes: Legacy mixed residue and terminal rejects are not valid feed. The machine puts heat into cabin gas; vacuum is not free cooling. Receiving, processing and storage unloading pause on reload.

groups.title: F6 Electric Furnace
groups.function: Electrically heats an exact aluminium charge to cast a rough machinery housing.
groups.use: Build or buy the furnace, install it with a compatible cooling endpoint and power. Use the local panel to load (or Load feed by crew for single aluminium pieces), seal, heat and cast, then cool, equalize and release products. Follow the complete cycle guide, or choose [Repeat batches](furnace-player-guide.md#repeat-batches) to seal, run, equalize and release each full charge automatically. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy machinery or assemble three F6-S sections. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below. Final assembly now takes place at the installation site through Install on a section or INSTALL > APPS; a complete loose machine keeps its direct Install action.
groups.notes: Requires finite cooling and a valid gas receiver. Direct coupling can transfer heat without power; piped circulation requires pump electricity. Automatic material receipt never authorizes Seal, Start or Release; only an explicitly started repeat run does, and it pauses on any manoeuvre, interruption, manual control or reload. Hot machinery retains heat across saves.

groups.title: F6-R Exterior Radiator
groups.function: Rejects furnace heat through a finite exterior cooling assembly.
groups.use: Install in the documented exterior location and pair with the F6. Direct coupling or the optional dedicated coolant route is supported.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: One cooling endpoint per furnace. Direct coupling is passive; a remote piped installation needs powered circulation. A disconnected exposed radiator still rejects heat already in its own store. It is not an unlimited heat sink; do not switch pairs or modes while hot. If older saves left cargo inside, choose Recover stored cargo while beside the unit and move the items out. New deposits are blocked. Maintenance information identifies contents, coolant, heat and paired-equipment restrictions. Actual work lots remain reserved until their native job finishes or is cancelled.

groups.title: F6-P Thermal Exhaust Port
groups.function: A sealed deck fitting representing the alternative underside radiator assembly.
groups.use: Install at the documented furnace-side cooling attachment, rotated with the F6, and select its cooling pairing.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: The small head represents a complete finite assembly. It keeps the native floor sealed and does not vent cabin air or create a lower deck. If older saves left cargo inside, choose Recover stored cargo while beside the unit and move the items out. New deposits are blocked. Maintenance information identifies contents, coolant, heat and paired-equipment restrictions. Actual work lots remain reserved until their native job finishes or is cancelled.

groups.title: F6-C Sealed Coolant Conduit
groups.function: Provides the separate coolant route between the F6 and a remote F6-R.
groups.use: Place contiguous segments through HVAC, connect the correct cooling endpoints and select piped mode while cool and empty. Use the furnace’s checked routing controls.
groups.find: Buy ordinary supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: This is not electrical cable or irrigation pipe. Legacy sealed operation and optional finite coolant servicing have different requirements. Damaged forms retain separate identities even when the display name lacks a damage suffix. Loose intact and damaged sections support storage stacks, separately by identity; installed segments remain individual fixtures. Split off a section when an action requires an individual item.

groups.title: C1 Industrial Control Console
groups.function: Provides central status and checked commands for installed industrial equipment on its own ship, with optional Agriculture integration.
groups.use: Install, power and use the seated console. Select a machine; filter by name, type or attention state and issue the available service commands. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy from equipment offers or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Physical cargo access and maintenance remain local. Docked, moored and towed ships are separate scopes; C1 is not required for autonomous processing.

groups.title: S3, S4 and S5 Process Water Silos
groups.function: Passive vessels holding process water as a saved record: the 3 x 3 S3 holds 1,000 kg, the 4 x 4 S4 1,960 kg and the 5 x 5 S5 3,330 kg. Bigger silos hold more for less per kilogram of capacity; a full silo weighs its housing plus its water.
groups.use: Install through APPS; no power or inventory. Fill at a station under Bulk supplies, from a linked T2 within one tile, or (with Ship's Water 0.16.1) draw from the drinking-water tanks above the crew reserve; send water to the waste tanks for the Recycler. Set Keep in reserve on the panel or C1, in steps of the silo's size. After damage, repair and Recover trapped water; a protected silo offers Accept contents as they are. See [the silo guide](shipbreaker-bulk-silos.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. The S3 may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; the S4 and S5 are too big to turn up in salvage. See the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Process water only: never a drinking-water tank, never fuel. Uninstalling carries the water with the loose silo; Dismantle is refused while water remains, and removal is refused while the silo is protected. Water is lost with a destroyed silo (logged). A linked Agriculture R3 and, with Phobos Manufacturing, the X2, V4 and K2 use or fill silo water.

groups.title: Y2, Y3 and Y4 Material Bins
groups.function: Sealed, unpowered stores for mined material: ore, loose regolith, gangue, water and methane ice, ice gangue and mined chunks such as clay hydrates. The 2 x 2 Y2 has a 4 x 4 grid, the 3 x 3 Y3 a 6 x 6 grid and the 4 x 4 Y4 an 8 x 8 grid; ore stacks six to a cell, so a Y2 holds about a tonne of ore. Every block keeps its own identity and mass.
groups.use: Install through FURN like the game's Storage Bay, then open its Inventory and put mined material in. Crew treat an installed bin as an ordinary unlocked container: Load feed by crew can fetch from it (choose it, or leave the ship-wide search on) and a machine's crew order can send gangue and other mined products into it. It takes nothing but mined material. See [the bin guide](shipbreaker-material-bins.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. The Y2 may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; the Y3 and Y4 are too big to turn up in salvage. See the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Uninstalling carries the contents with the loose bin, as the game's own Storage Bay does, so a full bin is very heavy. Dismantle is refused until the bin is empty. The D4 and R4 storage outputs do not list bins, because bins refuse their scrap products.

groups.title: T2 Ice Thaw Unit
groups.function: Thaws one block of the game's water ice (24.7 kg) at a time into 22.7 kg of process water for a linked silo or R3 reservoir plus one 2 kg gangue packet in its tray. It also breaks down methane ice (24.84 kg): 19.89 kg of water to the silo and 2.95 kg of methane to a linked Phobos Manufacturing methane store, never into the air.
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of the vessel, connect power, choose Deliver water to on its panel or C1, place single ice blocks in the Ice Feed (Inventory opens the tray and the feed) or switch on Load feed by crew, then Start / resume thawing. 6 kW for 40 minutes a block of water ice, 50 minutes for methane ice; part of it warms the room. For methane ice also choose Send methane to on the panel (it appears once a methane store is within one tile). See [the silo guide](shipbreaker-bulk-silos.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below. No fabrication recipe. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Gangue and stacked blocks are refused; methane ice waits until a methane store is linked, and crew only bring it once one is. Nothing warms until the linked vessel has room for a whole block; a hot or airless room makes it wait. Reload pauses it; Start or a crew order resumes. Empty the two-cell gangue tray by hand or a crew output store.

groups.title: D4-S assembly section
groups.function: A heavy, unpowered construction component, not a functional machine.
groups.use: Choose Assembly information on the section for instructions. Choose Install on it, or D4 in INSTALL > APPS, and place the construction site. Native hauling delivers two matching sections separately; use Mortorq and soldering tools to finish the installed machine. Final assembly does not use a table. See [construction sites](section-assembly-and-maintenance.md).
groups.find: Construct from materials, buy the listed section offers, or obtain a native engineering-loot section.
groups.notes: Sections use the drag slot, not your hands. A section already held in an older save remains there until released. Native site cancellation returns delivered parts; save/reload keeps the site and its work. Dismantle salvages the section rather than assembling it. Old table action identities remain for saved queues, but no longer appear as new offers. The site shows an unfinished frame while parts arrive, then open machinery once the full bill is present and work starts; the finished form appears only after completion.

groups.title: R4-S assembly section
groups.function: A heavy, unpowered construction component, not a functional machine.
groups.use: Choose Assembly information on the section for instructions. Choose Install on it, or R4 in INSTALL > APPS, and place the construction site. Native hauling delivers two matching sections separately; use Mortorq and soldering tools to finish the installed machine. Final assembly does not use a table. See [construction sites](section-assembly-and-maintenance.md).
groups.find: Construct from materials, buy the listed section offers, or obtain a native engineering-loot section.
groups.notes: Sections use the drag slot, not your hands. A section already held in an older save remains there until released. Native site cancellation returns delivered parts; save/reload keeps the site and its work. Dismantle salvages the section rather than assembling it. Old table action identities remain for saved queues, but no longer appear as new offers. The site shows an unfinished frame while parts arrive, then open machinery once the full bill is present and work starts; the finished form appears only after completion.

groups.title: F6-S furnace assembly section
groups.function: A heavy, unpowered construction component, not a functional machine.
groups.use: Choose Assembly information on the section for instructions. Choose Install on it, or F6 in INSTALL > APPS, and place the construction site. Native hauling delivers three matching sections separately; use Mortorq and soldering tools to finish the installed machine. Final assembly does not use a table. See [construction sites](section-assembly-and-maintenance.md).
groups.find: Construct from materials, buy the listed section offers, or obtain a native engineering-loot section.
groups.notes: Sections use the drag slot, not your hands. A section already held in an older save remains there until released. Native site cancellation returns delivered parts; save/reload keeps the site and its work. Dismantle salvages the section rather than assembling it. Old table action identities remain for saved queues, but no longer appear as new offers. The site shows an unfinished frame while parts arrive, then open machinery once the full bill is present and work starts; the finished form appears only after completion.

groups.title: Rough aluminium machinery housing
groups.function: The released rough casting from the first F6 recipe.
groups.use: Finish it through the table recipe, or choose explicit aluminium recovery if you no longer need it.
groups.find: Released from a completed and safely cooled F6 casting batch.
groups.notes: Its old recipe identity is preserved; it is not a finished Manufacturing heat sink.

groups.title: Finished aluminium machinery housing
groups.function: A finished construction input for optional D4-S and R4-S casting-based recipes.
groups.use: Use the listed section recipes; alternatively cut it back into aluminium using the explicit recovery recipe.
groups.find: Finish a rough F6 housing at a supported table.
groups.notes: This is cargo, not a fixture. Recovery preserves mass but yields much less base value than the whole housing.

groups.title: Terminal aluminium melt remainder
groups.function: Retained casting-process remainder.
groups.use: Keep as physical waste or offer to a compatible buyer.
groups.find: Appears with released F6 casting products.
groups.notes: No current remelting or reclaimer recipe accepts it; its small value is not a recovery yield.

groups.title: Aluminium ingot
groups.function: A 4 kg cast aluminium ingot: the raw stock for coming Phobos Manufacturing machining.
groups.use: Choose the aluminium-ingots recipe on the F6 (panel, C1 or F3) and run a twenty-scrap charge: four ingots, three scrap gates and one melt remainder are released. Keep ingots as stock, sell them as metals, or cut one back into four aluminium scraps at a table (Recover aluminium from ingot). See [F6 recipes](furnace-player-guide.md#recipes-housings-and-ingots).
groups.find: Released from a completed and cooled F6 aluminium-ingot charge, or bought as ordinary supply from the sellers below.
groups.notes: Stacks to ten. Recovery to scrap loses value; the ingot is worth more than the four scraps it holds. No machine consumes ingots until Manufacturing arrives.

groups.title: Steel ingot
groups.function: A 4 kg cast steel ingot from the F6 steel charge: the raw stock for coming Phobos Manufacturing machining.
groups.use: Choose the steel-ingots recipe on the F6 and load twenty 1 kg steel scraps; the hotter, longer cycle releases four ingots, three steel scrap gates and one steel melt remainder. Keep, sell, or cut one back into four steel scraps at a table (Recover steel from ingot). See [F6 recipes](furnace-player-guide.md#recipes-housings-and-ingots).
groups.find: Released from a completed and cooled F6 steel-ingot charge, or bought as ordinary supply from the sellers below.
groups.notes: Stacks to ten. Recovery to scrap loses value. The steel cycle needs well over half again the energy of an aluminium cycle through the same cooling assembly.

groups.title: Terminal steel melt remainder
groups.function: Retained steel casting-process remainder.
groups.use: Keep as physical waste or offer to a compatible buyer.
groups.find: Appears with released F6 steel-ingot products.
groups.notes: No remelting or reclaimer recipe accepts it; its small value is not a recovery yield. Distinct from the aluminium melt remainder.

groups.title: Identified Panel Residue R2
groups.function: Characterized gameplay feed for the R4.
groups.use: Load into R4 feed or transfer through an explicitly enabled route.
groups.find: Fresh revision-2 D4 wall jobs.
groups.notes: The authored result is steel, aluminium and terminal R2 rejects. It is not a measured chemical assay.

groups.title: Mixed Panel Residue — legacy
groups.function: Unclassified residue preserved from older D4 jobs and saves.
groups.use: Retain or move with supported collectors; do not substitute it for identified R2 feed.
groups.find: Existing cargo or completion of a job bound to the historical output contract.
groups.notes: No conversion to R2 and no R4 recycling; saving or updating does not reclassify it.

groups.title: Terminal Panel Rejects R2
groups.function: The nonrecoverable remainder of the R4 process.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing an R4 batch of identified panel residue.
groups.notes: Cannot be fed back through R4 to roll for more metals.

groups.title: Floor Grate Rejects R1
groups.function: The terminal remainder of a floor grate after the D4 takes its steel, aluminium and fittings, one kilogram a unit.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted. Units stack to ten.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of any floor grate make.
groups.notes: No further recipe; never re-processed. Leaves through the D4 storage output or by hand.

groups.title: DuraWal Rejects R1
groups.function: The 9.6 kg laminated remainder of a DuraWal interior wall.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of a DuraWal interior wall.
groups.notes: No further recipe; never re-processed.

groups.title: Window Rejects R1
groups.function: The 6 kg glazing-and-seals remainder of a window panel.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of a window panel.
groups.notes: The game has no glass item to recover. No further recipe.

groups.title: Whipple Rejects R1
groups.function: The 1.5 kg mesh-and-bonding remainder of a Whipple shielding panel.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of a Whipple shielding panel.
groups.notes: No further recipe; never re-processed.

groups.title: Aero Panel Rejects R1
groups.function: The 2.1 kg composite core remainder of an aerodynamic panel.
groups.use: Store, haul or sell where accepted.
groups.find: Completing a D4 batch of an aerodynamic panel.
groups.notes: No further recipe; never re-processed.

groups.title: Thermal Service Fluid Charge
groups.function: Fresh fictional industrial coolant for optional finite F6 servicing.
groups.use: In cool, idle piped mode enable finite servicing, place charges in Products and load locally. Prime before operating.
groups.find: Ordinary supply, fixer or Halvorson stock as listed below.
groups.notes: Not drinking water, irrigation feed or ammonia. The legacy sealed cooling mode does not require these charges. Fresh thermal service fluid charges support storage stacks of three. Split off one before furnace filling; retained coolant remains individual.

groups.title: Retained Thermal Service Fluid
groups.function: Physically retained fluid drained or captured from the optional coolant service.
groups.use: Recover through local coolant-drain controls and store the resulting cargo.
groups.find: F6 finite coolant draining and captured-loss recovery.
groups.notes: Live mass may differ from the template below. No current conversion back to a fresh service charge or potable water is provided.

groups.title: Retained Coolant Conduit Waste
groups.function: Terminal material left after dismantling F6-C.
groups.use: Keep as waste cargo or trade where accepted.
groups.find: Dismantling an intact or damaged F6-C segment.
groups.notes: It is not a fresh pipe or a coolant charge.

groups.title: Built-in feed compartments
groups.function: Named child inventories built into D4, R4, F6 and T2. They are not separate products.
groups.use: Open the compartment from the machine's Control Panel (the ordinary Inventory is the product tray) and put only its accepted structural parts (ordinary walls of any make, floor grates, DuraWal, Whipple and aero panels, windows), R2 residue, single 1 kg pieces of the metal the selected furnace recipe takes, or single blocks of water ice there, or switch on Load feed by crew.
groups.find: Shown as feed/chamber inventory within their owning machine.
groups.notes: No purchase, INSTALL, repair, Restore or standalone salvage contract. Empty-machine checks include these compartments.

PhobosAgriculture.intro: Verdemorrow equipment grows potatoes and lettuce, cooks potato portions and manages finite irrigation. These are authored, accelerated gameplay systems. Crop yields and simplified nutrient/treatment chemistry are not research results. The linked research guide attributes the supporting work separately; none of the pricing or yield balance implies NASA/ESA endorsement. See [research and attribution](development/agriculture-research.md). Regional offers extend through the current vanilla solar system; see [market coverage and the game's market pricing](solar-system-economy.md). Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). In selection fields, Locate opens a temporary marked ship view; Clear is a draft change that requires Apply. Pick on ship marks eligible objects and Escape restores the panel and view.

groups.title: Firstlight-4 Cultivation Rack
groups.function: Grows one potato, food-lettuce or lettuce-seed cohort across four visual trays.
groups.use: Install and power the rack, load irrigation and nutrients, then perform Plant. Keep cabin conditions suitable and Harvest when ready. Remove output cargo before replanting. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy equipment or build at a supported table; used/refurbished/damaged offers are listed below. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Four trays are one crop batch. Food lettuce does not return seeds; choose the dedicated seed cycle. The local panel shows inventory, stress and progress.

groups.title: Hearth-2 Galley Cooker
groups.function: Cooks a raw potato portion into edible prepared food.
groups.use: Install, power, place raw potatoes in its Inventory and Start. Collect the cooked portion when complete. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy equipment or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Its counter and stove artwork are one machine. Each job binds a particular raw portion; replacing it does not transfer progress.

groups.title: Groundwork W2 Water Supply Unit
groups.function: Stores and supplies irrigation water or formulated nutrient solution; also treats recorded process solution.
groups.use: Install and power W2, load supplies locally, choose formulation, pair supported racks and explicitly enable receiving/distribution. Use treatment controls for recorded drainage and a cartridge. Select a physical nutrient charge while paused for gradual consumption during powered blending. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or build at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Use separate circuits for incompatible formulations. Receiving pauses after reload. Optional [Valtora’s Ship’s Water](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3757331189) integration is version-scoped and protects crew reserves; manual input remains available.

groups.title: Groundwork Irrigation Conduit
groups.function: Carries irrigation water or crop nutrient solution between W2 and paired racks.
groups.use: Place contiguous segments in MISC, connect the pipe sockets and use Pair/Receive controls.
groups.find: Buy stock, build at a supported table, or find a loose segment in eligible locked-crate contents. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Separate from electricity and F6 coolant. Removing a line does not delete the contents retained at its receiving machine. Loose intact and damaged sections support storage stacks, separately by identity; installed segments remain individual fixtures. Split off a section when an action requires an individual item.

groups.title: Continuance Seed Potato
groups.function: Planting stock for a potato crop.
groups.use: Place one in the rack and choose Plant potato after loading water and nutrients.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible fridge/crate loot, or retain stock from a potato harvest. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability.
groups.notes: This is the sprouted planting item, not a raw edible portion. Split off one seed potato or seed packet before manual planting; an intact stack is not a planting input. Crew source hauling can deliver individual units from stacks.

groups.title: Continuance Lettuce Seeds
groups.function: Planting stock for either lettuce cycle.
groups.use: Load one packet, then choose food lettuce or the separate lettuce-for-seed cycle.
groups.find: Buy stock, find eligible fridge/crate loot, or harvest a completed lettuce-seed cohort. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability.
groups.notes: Food-lettuce harvest gives leaves, not replacement seed packets. Split off one seed potato or seed packet before manual planting; an intact stack is not a planting input. Crew source hauling can deliver individual units from stacks.

groups.title: Groundwork Formulated Crop Nutrients
groups.function: Dry finite nutrient input.
groups.use: Put packets in the rack or W2 and choose Load nutrients; W2 can blend the selected formulation. Alternatively select the exact physical packet in W2 while paused for gradual dosing; no Repair or Restore.
groups.find: Buy supplies or find eligible locked-crate loot.
groups.notes: Not fertilizer produced from arbitrary trash; unused loaded nutrients remain finite stored stock. Storage stacks retain individual packets and charge records. Split off one packet before manual loading, W2 dosing or B2 formulation; an intact stack is not a processing input. Crew source hauling can deliver individual units from stacks. Stacking does not replenish partially used packets.

groups.title: Groundwork Irrigation Charge
groups.function: A sealed root-water input commodity.
groups.use: Place in the rack or W2 and use Load irrigation charge with enough free reservoir space.
groups.find: Buy supplies or find eligible locked-crate loot.
groups.notes: Not a drinkable ration. Native water rations are an alternative input, not a conversion output. Irrigation charges support storage stacks of three. Split off one before manual water loading; per-charge quantity is unchanged.

groups.title: Raw Potatoes
groups.function: Uncooked potato harvest portions.
groups.use: Move to Hearth-2 and Start cooking.
groups.find: Harvest potatoes or find eligible fridge contents. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability.
groups.notes: The current raw item has no Eat action; use the cooker. It is not a seed potato. Raw potato portions support storage stacks. Separate one portion before placing it in the cooker; a whole stack is not a cooker input. Each portion retains its original mass.

groups.title: Hearth Cooked Potatoes
groups.function: Prepared crew food.
groups.use: Collect from Hearth-2 and use the Eat action.
groups.find: Cook raw potatoes or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability.
groups.notes: Food effects are values chosen for gameplay. Portions support storage stacks; mass and food effects remain per individual portion.

groups.title: Lettuce
groups.function: Edible leaves from the food-lettuce crop.
groups.use: Harvest, collect and eat through the usual food actions.
groups.find: Harvest food lettuce or find eligible fridge loot. See the listed merchant offers for current retail availability.
groups.notes: Not seed stock. Growing lettuce for seed produces no edible leaves. Portions support storage stacks; mass and food effects remain per individual portion.

groups.title: Crop Residue
groups.function: Retained nonfood crop biomass, including growth losses and rounding.
groups.use: Remove it from rack storage as physical waste.
groups.find: Old harvests and cohorts planted before recovery recording.
groups.notes: Legacy unrecorded variable-mass residue. B2 preserves this identity and cannot infer nutrients from it.

groups.title: Agricultural Process Solution — unrecorded
groups.function: Legacy or otherwise uncharacterized retained process liquid.
groups.use: Keep and haul it as nonpotable retained cargo.
groups.find: Older crop/process outputs and preserved saves.
groups.notes: No recorded composition: W2 treatment must not infer one or silently upgrade this item.

groups.title: Recorded Process Solution
groups.function: Drainage with saved water/nutrient quantities that W2 can validate.
groups.use: Place alongside a usable treatment cartridge in W2; queue drainage treatment, then Start and provide power/output space.
groups.find: New recorded drainage and retained solution recovery.
groups.notes: Live mass/composition comes from the saved batch. Recovery is partial, with terminal rejects, and never returns drinking water.

groups.title: Groundwork Treatment Cartridge
groups.function: Finite treatment medium used by W2.
groups.use: Place with recorded drainage and queue treatment. Keep returned part-used cartridges for later batches.
groups.find: Buy supplies or find eligible locked-crate loot.
groups.notes: The table shows a full cartridge; remaining capacity controls live mass and price. Historical bound jobs may consume a whole cartridge. Cartridges support storage stacks of three separate objects. Split off one before treatment. Each retains its own remaining capacity; a batch must fit one cartridge, and stacking never pools or refills capacity.

groups.title: Retained Treatment Rejects
groups.function: Spent medium and unrecovered material from W2 treatment.
groups.use: Collect and retain as waste cargo.
groups.find: Completion of drainage treatment.
groups.notes: Actual packet mass varies; it cannot be treated again for another recovery roll.

groups.title: Agricultural Housing Waste
groups.function: Terminal housing remainders from equipment dismantling. Several different masses share this display name.
groups.use: Use the origin and mass below to identify the packet; keep or trade it as waste.
groups.find: Produced with recoverable materials by Dismantle.
groups.notes: Not construction stock, planting medium or R4 feed. The distinct identities must not be combined into a new salvage recipe.

groups.title: Groundwork B2 Workup Bench
groups.function: Recovers recorded crop nutrients and formulates finite W2 mixtures.
groups.use: Install through APPS, power, load a recorded residue packet, prepare recovery and Start. Then prepare recovered concentrate plus equal-mass makeup salts and Start. Leave output room. Supported crew work is configured through the [standing-order controls](crew-automation.md); orders begin disabled and retain the existing access and supply requirements.
groups.find: Buy supply/fixer/Halvorson stock or construct at a supported table. This item may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; see the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Each stage binds physical inputs, consumes power and pauses after reload. Damaged hardware is repairable; consumable contents are not.

groups.title: Recorded Crop Residue
groups.function: Retained wet crop matter with a bounded saved nutrient allocation.
groups.use: Process at B2; empty or unrecorded nutrient budgets are not eligible.
groups.find: Harvest or clear a cohort planted from Agriculture 0.9.0 onward.
groups.notes: Actual mass and allocation vary. Old residue and old cohorts are not reassayed.

groups.title: Recovered Nutrient Concentrate
groups.function: Recovered nutrient concentrate. Add makeup salts at B2 before using it for plants.
groups.use: Formulate at B2 with equal-mass Groundwork makeup salts.
groups.find: B2 crop recovery only; a spawned unrecorded template is unusable.
groups.notes: Cannot feed plants directly. Saved composition must match physical mass.

groups.title: Groundwork Makeup Salts
groups.function: Supplement salts for mixing with recovered nutrient concentrate.
groups.use: Place at B2 with concentrate; retain returned partial packets.
groups.find: Buy supply/fixer/Halvorson stock.
groups.notes: Full packet values below; partial mass and value decrease. Cannot Repair or Restore; not a complete nutrient substitute. Storage stacks retain individual packets and charge records. Split off one packet before manual loading, W2 dosing or B2 formulation; an intact stack is not a processing input. Crew source hauling can deliver individual units from stacks. Stacking does not replenish partially used packets.

groups.title: Recovered Crop Nutrient Mixture
groups.function: Finished finite nutrient charge for W2 blending.
groups.use: Place in W2, pause operation and receiving, select this exact charge and desired formulation, then Start.
groups.find: B2 formulation from recorded concentrate plus makeup salts.
groups.notes: No automatic packet substitution. Mass and value decrease with actual blending; cannot Repair or Restore. Template value is not a usable unrecorded charge.

groups.title: Spent Crop Biomass
groups.function: All residue material remaining after concentrate recovery.
groups.use: Remove from B2 and retain as waste cargo.
groups.find: B2 recovery.
groups.notes: Variable mass includes water and unrecovered nutrients; cannot reroll for further recovery.

groups.title: Recycler Wet Rejects
groups.function: Measured wet remainder from an optionally attached Ship’s Water Recycler.
groups.use: Collect from a linked powered Phobos Residue Collector; remove full packets manually.
groups.find: Opt-in attachment with Ship’s Water 0.16.1 and Shipbreaker 0.20.0.
groups.notes: Maximum 13 kg per packet and 52 kg per collector. Uncharacterized water remainder; no B2 fertilizer recipe or industrial reclaimer route.

groups.title: Groundwork R3, R4 and R5 Agricultural Water Reservoirs
groups.function: Passive agricultural water buffers for one explicitly paired W2: 120 kg in the 3 x 3 R3, 235 kg in the 4 x 4 R4 and 400 kg in the 5 x 5 R5. Storage and catch share one capacity; they add no pump power.
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of a W2 (the original R3 layout against its right edge still works; a Shipbreaker silo can also feed a W2). Pause W2, Apply the reservoir connection, choose reserve/refill target, then explicitly enable W2 receiving and Resume. Fill through station Bulk supplies or put 5 kg irrigation charges in its inventory and Load. Routine crew loading is opt-in.
groups.find: Empty loose hardware at Agriculture supply/fixer/Halvorson and supported regional merchants; finite lots of four. No fabrication recipe. The R3 may also appear in eligible engineering-equipment loot; the R4 and R5 never do. See the exact offers below.
groups.notes: Damage isolates the water in a finite catch. Repair does not recover or resume it: use Recover locally. Explicit lossy Drain creates recorded treatment feed, at most 20 kg per action. Filled, linked or uncertain storage cannot be uninstalled/dismantled. Whole-ship disposal remains native. Not a potable tank, feed-mixture tank or drainage receiver.

groups.title: Groundwork Bulk Nutrient Charge
groups.function: One physical 500 g dry formulated nutrient charge for gradual selected W2 dosing.
groups.use: Put in the W2 inventory; pause, select its exact charge in Supplies, Apply and Resume. Explicitly choose the distribute-and-replace standing order to authorize crew replacement from the approved input store.
groups.find: Agriculture merchants in finite lots of eight, or one charge per independent station Bulk supplies purchase into a selected W2 inventory.
groups.notes: Same aggregate formulation value per kg as existing nutrients. Dedicated bulk nutrient packet artwork, localized name and measured mass distinguish it. No water carrier or new chemical assay. Remaining mass/value decrease; empty charges vanish. No Repair/Restore. Bulk charges support storage stacks of three individual objects. Split off one before dosing; partially depleted charges retain their own contents.

PhobosFramework.intro: Framework supplies shared services rather than a set of standalone machines. Its shared repair remainder can appear while servicing equipment from any participating Phobos content mod. Construction menus, machinery controls and the opt-in Scope recorder are interfaces, not additional inventory objects. Crew standing orders are opt-in; see [crew work, training and time-skips](crew-automation.md) for eligible work, approved stores, resource limits and resuming industrial and exterior work. Compact controls, unsaved settings and object selection are explained in the [control-panel guide](control-panel-guide.md). In selection fields, Locate opens a temporary marked ship view; Clear is a draft change that requires Apply. Pick on ship marks eligible objects and Escape restores the panel and view.

groups.title: Spent Service Parts
groups.function: Material physically retained from the actual repair bill after replacing worn or broken components.
groups.use: Collect or haul the spent parts after repair; sell only where a buyer accepts the cargo.
groups.find: Native Repair jobs on supported Auto Nav, Shipbreaker and Agriculture equipment.
groups.notes: The definition below is a template. Live mass follows the real consumed repair lot, including old jobs with different bills. No current refining recipe returns new electronic or mechanical parts.

PhobosManufacturing.intro: Phobos Manufacturing refines what the crew mines and runs the first chemistry aboard: the Fennmark V4 Volatiles Refinery, the X2 Chemical Processor (water electrolysis), the K2 Sabatier Reactor, hydrogen, methane, oxygen, nitrogen and carbon dioxide stores in three sizes each, the P1 RCS Propellant Manifold, the L2 Canister Filling Station and the A2 Cabin Air Regulator, with nickel-iron ingots and carbon stock as raw stock, two terminal remainders and one new minable chunk. Every charge conserves mass and is recorded with its chemistry and sources in [the refinery design record](development/manufacturing-refinery-and-chemistry.md); operating instructions are in [the player guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md). Machines are purchase-only; ores and chunks are mined, never bought; bulk oxygen, nitrogen and carbon dioxide are sold only through the station Bulk supplies view. The machines are late-game plant, priced among the game's own radars, heavy lift rotors and missile launchers; they carry the game's high-salvage mark, need component repairs and are rare world finds. See [the equipment economy](equipment-economy.md#manufacturing-011-late-game-plant).

groups.title: V4 Volatiles Refinery
groups.function: A 4 x 4 electric hearth and drying retort. One charge at a time: hydrates (10 kg) to 1 kg of water and three gangue; clay hydrates to 2 kg of water and an 8 kg anhydrous residue; carbon ore to five carbon stock, 1 kg of water, one gangue and 1 kg of CO2, CO and smoke breathed into the room; meteoric iron to four nickel-iron ingots, one gangue and 1 kg of slag; with Shipbreaker, four nickel-iron ingots and one carbon stock to four steel ingots and a melt remainder.
groups.use: Install through APPS, connect power, link a water vessel (S3 or R3 within one tile) on its panel or C1 for the water charges, load one charge into its feed (the Inventory opens the tray and the feed), then Start. 24 kW while working; part of it warms the room. Run a scrubber in its room for the carbon charge. See [the player guide](manufacturing-player-guide.md).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices. No fabrication recipe. About one engineering-loot roll in twenty yields a Fennmark machine, usually broken; see the exact offers below. The K-Leg fixer buys it back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: A melt (nickel-iron or steel) left waiting for a cool room longer than its own run freezes into slag. Reload pauses it; Start resumes the bound charge. A steel charge saved before Shipbreaker is removed is kept, never overwritten. Empty the tray by hand.

groups.title: X2 Chemical Processor
groups.function: A 2 x 2 water electrolysis cell. Each one-hour cycle at 6 kW splits 1.125 kg of water into 1.000 kg of oxygen and 0.125 kg of hydrogen (2 H2O to 2 H2 + O2).
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of a water vessel and an H2 store, connect power, link both on its panel or C1, choose an installed O2 canister within one tile (or leave it on cabin air), then Start. It runs only while every output has room; a full canister or store makes it wait.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices. No fabrication recipe. About one engineering-loot roll in twenty yields a Fennmark machine, usually broken; see the exact offers below. The K-Leg fixer buys it back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: Oxygen into the cabin raises the oxygen partial pressure, which raises the game's own fire chance. Reload pauses it; Start resumes with the held water and cycle energy kept. Cancel forfeits the cycle's energy, never the water.

groups.title: H2, H3 and H4 Hydrogen Stores
groups.function: Passive pressurised stores for electrolysis hydrogen (24, 59 and 115 kg), kept as a kilogram record (hydrogen has no game gas). Three sizes: small 2 x 2, medium 3 x 3 and large 4 x 4, each one tile wider and holding more for less per kilogram.
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of an X2 (which fills it) and, for the Sabatier stage, a K2 (which draws from it); link them from those machines. Vent overboard or pour into another store of the same gas (within one tile or along a gas line) from its panel or C1. Repair damage at once and empty it before uninstalling. It can also feed the RCS through a P1 manifold (within one tile or by gas line; switched off until you turn it on).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices, and the bigger sizes cost less per kilogram held. No fabrication recipe. The small size is a rare engineering-loot find, usually broken; the medium and large sizes are too big to turn up in salvage. The K-Leg fixer buys them back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: Damaged, a store leaks to space (about 2, 3 or 4 kg an hour by size) until repaired. With oxygen in the room and a fire, a working V4 hearth or a sparking damaged device, its contents burn: the room loses oxygen and warms, and the game's own explosion follows. Dismantling refuses while it holds hydrogen.

groups.title: K2 Sabatier Reactor
groups.function: A 2 x 2 catalytic Sabatier reactor, CO2 + 4 H2 -> CH4 + 2 H2O. Each one-hour cycle at 1.2 kW takes 0.125 kg of hydrogen (one X2 cycle) and 0.682 kg of CO2 and makes 0.559 kg of water and 0.249 kg of methane. The reaction and its electricity put about 2.3 kW into the room.
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of an H2 store, an installed native CO2 canister, a water vessel (S3 or R3) and an M2 methane store; connect power; link all four on its panel or C1; Start. Fill the CO2 canister with the game's CO2 scrubber. It waits, with the reason, while an input is short or an output full, and starts a new cycle only once the last cycle's products are delivered.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices. No fabrication recipe. About one engineering-loot roll in twenty yields a Fennmark machine, usually broken; see the exact offers below. The K-Leg fixer buys it back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: With the X2 it returns about half the water the X2 splits, as NASA's ISS system does. Damaged, it dumps the gas it holds: CO2 and methane into the room, and its hydrogen burns if the room has oxygen and a spark, otherwise it escapes; water stays in its hold. Reload pauses it until Start. Dismantling refuses while it holds gas, water or a part-run cycle.

groups.title: M2, M3 and M4 Methane Stores
groups.function: Passive pressurised stores for Sabatier methane (160, 395 and 770 kg), kept as a kilogram record, and a source of RCS propellant. Three sizes: small 2 x 2, medium 3 x 3 and large 4 x 4, each one tile wider and holding more for less per kilogram.
groups.use: Install through APPS within one tile of a K2 and link it from the reactor. Vent overboard or pour into another store of the same gas (within one tile or along a gas line) from its panel or C1. Repair damage at once and empty it before uninstalling. It feeds the RCS through a P1 manifold (within one tile or by gas line; switched off until you turn it on).
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices, and the bigger sizes cost less per kilogram held. No fabrication recipe. The small size is a rare engineering-loot find, usually broken; the medium and large sizes are too big to turn up in salvage. The K-Leg fixer buys them back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: Methane is one of the game's own gases: a damaged store leaks about 2, 3 or 4 kg an hour into the room (to space where there is no air) until repaired, and a destroyed one releases what it held. With oxygen in the room and a fire, a working V4 hearth or a sparking damaged device, its contents burn, using 4 kg of oxygen and leaving 2.7 kg of CO2 per kg of methane, with the game's own explosion. Dismantling refuses while it holds methane.

groups.title: O2, O3 and O4 Oxygen Stores
groups.function: Passive pressurised stores for bulk oxygen (340, 840 and 1,630 kg), kept as a kilogram record. Three sizes: small 2 x 2, medium 3 x 3 and large 4 x 4, each one tile wider and holding more for less per kilogram.
groups.use: Install through APPS. Fill it from an X2 (choose the store as the cell's oxygen destination) or buy bulk oxygen at a station's Bulk supplies. It feeds an L2 filling station, which tops up canisters and suit bottles, and the RCS through a P1 manifold. Vent overboard or pour into another store of the same gas (within one tile or along a gas line) from its panel or C1. Repair damage at once and empty it before uninstalling.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices, and the bigger sizes cost less per kilogram held. No fabrication recipe. The small size is a rare engineering-loot find, usually broken; the medium and large sizes are too big to turn up in salvage. The K-Leg fixer buys them back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: Oxygen is one of the game's own gases: a damaged store leaks about 2, 3 or 4 kg an hour into the room until repaired, and a destroyed one releases what it held. Oxygen-rich air makes any fire worse. Bought oxygen costs the refuelling kiosk's own price per kilogram; nothing sells back.

groups.title: N2, N3 and N4 Nitrogen Stores
groups.function: Passive pressurised stores for bulk nitrogen (300, 745 and 1,440 kg), kept as a kilogram record. Three sizes: small 2 x 2, medium 3 x 3 and large 4 x 4, each one tile wider and holding more for less per kilogram.
groups.use: Install through APPS and buy bulk nitrogen at a station's Bulk supplies. It feeds an L2 filling station, which refills RCS and air-pump canisters far from port, and the RCS directly through a P1 manifold. Vent overboard or pour into another store of the same gas (within one tile or along a gas line) from its panel or C1. Repair damage at once and empty it before uninstalling.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices, and the bigger sizes cost less per kilogram held. No fabrication recipe. The small size is a rare engineering-loot find, usually broken; the medium and large sizes are too big to turn up in salvage. The K-Leg fixer buys them back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: Nitrogen is one of the game's own gases: a damaged store leaks about 2, 3 or 4 kg an hour into the room until repaired, thinning the air without warning, and a destroyed one releases what it held. Bought nitrogen costs the refuelling kiosk's own price per kilogram; nothing sells back.

groups.title: C2, C3 and C4 Carbon Dioxide Stores
groups.function: Passive pressurised stores for bulk carbon dioxide (470, 1,160 and 2,260 kg), kept as a kilogram record. Three sizes: small 2 x 2, medium 3 x 3 and large 4 x 4, each one tile wider and holding more for less per kilogram.
groups.use: Install through APPS and buy bulk carbon dioxide at a station's Bulk supplies. A K2 draws its CO2 from one within one tile (choose it as the reactor's CO2 source); it also feeds an L2 filling station for CO2 canisters and the RCS through a P1 manifold. Vent overboard or pour into another store of the same gas (within one tile or along a gas line) from its panel or C1. Repair damage at once and empty it before uninstalling.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices, and the bigger sizes cost less per kilogram held. No fabrication recipe. The small size is a rare engineering-loot find, usually broken; the medium and large sizes are too big to turn up in salvage. The K-Leg fixer buys them back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: Carbon dioxide is one of the game's own gases and poisons the crew: a damaged store leaks about 2, 3 or 4 kg an hour into the room until repaired, and a destroyed one releases what it held. Bought CO2 costs the game's own price per kilogram; nothing sells back.

groups.title: L2 Canister Filling Station
groups.function: A powered 2 x 2 booster that tops up standard O2, N2 and CO2 canisters and suit O2 bottles to a safe 99% of their rated pressure and stops, even at fast-forward. Decant mode empties them back into bulk stores.
groups.use: Install through INSTALL > HVAC and power it from conduit. Put suit O2 bottles in its rack (Inventory), link canisters installed beside it, and link oxygen, nitrogen or carbon dioxide stores within one tile or along a gas line, switching each on. A linked canister can be set to Draw from it instead. Choose Fill or Decant, then press Start. After a reload it waits for Start. Right-click Keep suit bottles charged to have crew with the Haul duty bring loose bottles below 90% into the rack and start it; choose a destination store in the Crew panel for charged bottles.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices. No fabrication recipe. About one engineering-loot roll in twenty yields a Fennmark machine, usually broken.
groups.notes: Draws 3 kW while working; the electricity pays for compressing the gas (about 0.06 kWh per kilogram of oxygen into a canister) and all of it ends as heat in the room. Hydrogen and methane cannot be bottled: the game has no canister for them.

groups.title: A2 Cabin Air Regulator
groups.function: A powered 2 x 2 valve and sensor unit that holds the room it stands in at an oxygen set point from a linked oxygen store, then at a pressure set point from a linked nitrogen store. It only adds gas.
groups.use: Install through INSTALL > HVAC in the room to look after and power it from conduit. Link an oxygen store and, for pressure, a nitrogen store within one tile or along a gas line, choose the set points and press Switch on. It keeps working after a reload.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices. No fabrication recipe. About one engineering-loot roll in twenty yields a Fennmark machine, usually broken.
groups.notes: Up to 6 kg of oxygen and 12 kg of nitrogen an hour. It stops feeding a room below 10 kPa (open to space) and never lets oxygen pass 30% of the air. It never vents, scrubs carbon dioxide or cools: keep the scrubbers running.

groups.title: P1 RCS Propellant Manifold
groups.function: A passive 1 x 1 valve block that feeds the ship's RCS thrusters from Fennmark gas stores (hydrogen, methane, oxygen, nitrogen or carbon dioxide). Each gas pushes by its own worth: methane about 1.45 times nitrogen per kilogram, hydrogen about 3.7 times.
groups.use: Install through INSTALL > HVAC on an RCS Intake Regulator's gas-input tile, where a gas canister would go, with its line port facing away. Link up to four stores within one tile or along a gas line, switch each on, choose Manifold first or Canisters first, and switch the manifold on. Everything starts off.
groups.find: Buy loose hardware from the sellers below; it is late-game equipment with late-game prices. No fabrication recipe. About one engineering-loot roll in twenty yields a Fennmark machine, usually broken; see the exact offers below. The K-Leg fixer buys it back intact and the Venus scrap kiosk intact or broken.
groups.notes: Not a gas canister: station refuelling never fills it. Draws settle to the stores every couple of seconds and before a save. Auto Nav's fuel and delta-v readings count the stores in nitrogen-equivalent kilograms.

groups.title: Gas line
groups.function: Sealed gas line between Fennmark gas stores and the machines they feed (the P1 manifold, the L2 filling station and other stores), on the same tile-by-tile pattern as the other mods' conduits but its own family: it never joins coolant or irrigation lines. Its retained waste is what dismantling leaves.
groups.use: Lay it through INSTALL > HVAC on intact floor from a store's line port to a machine's or another store's. A damaged segment breaks the route until repaired.
groups.find: Sold new at the K-Leg supply kiosk and fixer, San Diego Halvorson and the Venus scrap kiosk in lots of 128. Ordinary supply, not late-game plant.
groups.notes: Hold-up and pressure drop along the line are neglected. The retained waste is terminal.

groups.title: Raw stock
groups.function: Nickel-iron ingots (4 kg, cast meteoric iron: iron with a few percent of nickel) and carbon stock (1 kg) are the refinery's products and Manufacturing's raw stock. Four ingots with one carbon make steel in the V4 when Shipbreaker is present; the coming machining centre consumes ingots.
groups.use: Made in the V4. Carry, stack (ten per stack) and sell at any general buyer; feed them back into the V4 as a steel charge.
groups.find: Made in the V4 from meteoric iron and carbon ore. Never sold in shops.
groups.notes: Ordinary raw-material prices; only the machines are late-game priced. Four ingots ($96) are worth less than the $450 meteoric iron block, five carbon ($50) plus water less than the $99 carbide ore, and four steel ingots ($100) less than the four nickel-iron ingots and carbon that make them ($106): refining loses money and gains material aboard. Scrap kiosks do not buy them, so they are never furnace or processor feed.

groups.title: Terminal remainders
groups.function: Refinery slag (1 kg: sulfide, phosphide and oxide skimmings, or a frozen melt) and anhydrous residue (8 kg of baked clay minerals). Trash at the technical minimum price; nothing recovers them.
groups.use: Carry them out of the tray and sell or discard them.
groups.find: Left in the V4 tray by its charges. Never sold.
groups.notes: Terminal: never re-processed, never the game's own Trash item.

groups.title: Clay hydrates
groups.function: A 10 kg chunk of dark, water-rich clay minerals of the kind sampled from carbonaceous asteroids, about a fifth of it bound water.
groups.use: Bake it in the V4 for 2 kg of water and an 8 kg residue, or sell it to a government kiosk like other ore.
groups.find: Mined: C-class deposits and dark regolith walls turn it up in place of some of the silicates they would otherwise give, about one C-class find in ten. Never sold.
groups.notes: Authored from the CI-chondrite range (18 to 22 percent water by weight) with the game's own hydrate art until its own sprite exists.

groups.title: Built-in charge feed
groups.function: The V4's charge feed, a named child inventory built into the machine. Not a separate product.
groups.use: Open it from the machine's Inventory and put single ore blocks, clay chunks, nickel-iron ingots or carbon stock there; the refinery binds one exact charge at a time.
groups.find: Shown as feed inventory within the V4.
groups.notes: No purchase, INSTALL, repair, Restore or standalone salvage contract.

groups.title: Gas deflagration
groups.function: The game's own explosion objects in three sizes, spawned for a moment when a damaged or destroyed fuel store (hydrogen or methane) or a damaged reactor's hydrogen burns. Not items.
groups.use: Not usable. They apply the game's radius damage, shrapnel and fire rolls and remove themselves.
groups.find: Only where stored fuel burns.
groups.notes: Their entries live in the mod's data/explosions file.

PhobosWarDeclared.intro: Phobos' War Has Been Declared adds no items, equipment or recipes. It adds three orders to the game's own navigation stations (Battle stations, Stand down and Lay held build sites) and lays the game's own build sites for parts destroyed in battle, which the crew finish with ordinary replacement parts. See [the player guide](war-declared-player-guide.md).
